Analysis_Settings: GMV: SPM12 VBM, images co-registered to the white matter tissue probability map, segmented, study-specific template spatially normalized to MNI space with DARTEL, 8 mm FWHM Gaussian smoothing, intensity threshold 0.2. CT: custom tissue probability map from Template-O-Matic (TOM8), segmentation in CAT12, 10 mm smoothing. Both: 2 x 2 full factorial model, voxel-wise height threshold p < 0.005 uncorrected, cluster-level extent threshold p < 0.05 FDR corrected.
Atlas_Parcellation: Brodmann areas and anatomical labels assigned with the label4MRI package
Covariates: GMV: total GMV, study site, scanner type, ADHD scores. CT: study site, scanner type, ADHD scores. Age and sex were not included.
Multiple_Comparison_Correction: Cluster-level FDR correction at p < 0.05 (voxel-wise height threshold p < 0.005, uncorrected)
Pulse_Sequence: T1-weighted; acquisition parameters are not given in the article (referred to the ABCD imaging protocol document)
Statistical_Test: 2 x 2 full factorial analysis (ANOVA): main effect of Reading Ability, main effect of Language Background, and their interaction
Study_Dataset: ABCD Study, Annual Release 3.0, baseline time point (NDA DOI 10.15154/gx74-8w05)
Study_Design_Type: 2 x 2 factorial group comparison (Reading Ability by Language Background) on ABCD baseline data
